The decisive mistake was WebServing_Expert's at step 6. The agent had already found the correct paper, and the IOPScience page was blocked by a CAPTCHA. Instead of trying other routes to the same paper, such as the arXiv version, NASA ADS, or a search for the acknowledgments text, it stopped and handed the task back to the user. That left ResearchFunding_Expert nothing to work with, and the later steps (7–9) only repeated the failure.
